Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.arena

Class WaveDirector

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.arena.WaveDirector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable
public final class WaveDirector extends Object implements Rewindable
Runs the Arena loop on top of an ArenaCycle: spawns each wave when it starts, tells the cycle when the wave is cleared, and lets the fixed break run between two waves. It is in the rewind photo (R) with its cycle, so a rewind to before a wave spawned spawns it again instead of counting it as cleared.

  • Method Details

    • onTick

      public void onTick(int enemiesAlive)
      Advances the Arena by one tick, called once per world tick.

      A wave that starts is spawned on that tick, and the count is read from the next tick on: the new enemies are not in enemiesAlive yet. A spawned wave with no enemy alive is cleared. The cycle then advances, which only counts down during a break.

      Parameters:
      enemiesAlive - the enemies of the world that are not dead, 0 or more
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if enemiesAlive is negative
